# Guilherme Vigneron de Oliveira — Portfolio

> This is the personal portfolio of Guilherme Vigneron de Oliveira, a Principal Software QA Engineer with 15+ years of experience.

## Summary
As a seasoned Quality Assurance Engineer with over 15 years of experience, I elevate software quality through innovative testing strategies and automation. My relentless pursuit of excellence, global collaboration, and attention to detail ensure every project achieves the highest standards. I am passionate about advancing quality assurance and eager to bring my innovative strategies to a forward-thinking team.

## Experience
- Principal Software QA Engineer at AVEVA (Nov 2023 - Present), Austin, TX
  - Led the development and implementation of comprehensive test strategies, achieving significant increases in test coverage and reductions in defects.
  - Designed and implemented robust test automation frameworks using Selenium and C#, enhancing maintainability and efficiency.
  - Orchestrated automated and manual testing processes using Azure DevOps, improving deployment reliability.
  - Conducted critical performance testing with JMeter to optimize software performance.
  - Led cross-functional teams as a Scrum Master, fostering collaboration and driving increases in sprint velocity.
- Senior QA Engineer at AVEVA (Sep 2018 - Aug 2024), São Paulo, Brazil
  - Headed the development of test strategies, increasing test coverage and reducing defects.
  - Designed a robust Page Object Model test framework using Selenium and C#.
  - Orchestrated testing processes using Azure DevOps release pipelines.
  - Mentored junior QA engineers, improving team productivity and knowledge sharing.
- Quality and Test Analyst at AVEVA (Oct 2008 - Sep 2018), São Paulo, Brazil
  - Led the implementation of a risk-based testing approach, prioritizing test cases based on business impact.
  - Pioneered the implementation of new test automation tools.
  - Collaborated with cross-functional teams to optimize the software development lifecycle.
  - Developed and delivered comprehensive training programs on testing techniques for QA analysts.

## Core Skills
